```
FT/
├── main.tex           # Driver: loads style, cover, content
├── style.tex          # Preamble + macros (\question{n}{marks}, \answerlines{n}, \sectionheader, \qmarks)
├── config.tex         # Paper metadata (year, code, type, marks, time, cover text, instructions)
├── cover.tex          # Single-page cover layout (title, instructions, candidate box, marks table)

    ├── q8.tex         # Q8 (8 marks): temperature changes
```

% ------------------------------------------------------------
% Answer space: n ruled lines.
%
% Each ruled line is tall enough to allow handwriting. The marks label
% (set by \question) is overlaid on the right of the LAST answer line
% of the LAST \answerlines call in the question, so the marks appear
% at the bottom-right of the question without taking any extra
% vertical space.
%
% The rule width is the text-width minus a small left/right margin
% (so the lines are NOT flush with the page frame). \AnswerLineWidth
% is computed relative to the current \linewidth: -10mm so the rules
% leave a 5mm visual gap on each side of the line.
%
% \vfill is inserted before the last \answerlines block and after each
% intermediate block so the blocks (and the last block's last line)
% spread to fill the remaining vertical space on the page.
% ------------------------------------------------------------
\newif\ifmarkspending
\newif\iffirstanswerlines
\newcommand{\answerlines}[1]{%
  \par
  \ifmarkspending
    % this is the LAST block of the question - paint marks on the
    % last rule, and use \vfill before so the last line lands near
    % the bottom of the page.
    \vspace{2mm}
    \vfill
    \foreach \i in {1,...,#1}{%
      \ifnum\i=#1\relax
        \vspace{12mm}\noindent\rlap{\hbox to \AnswerLineWidth{\hss\CurrentQuestionMarks}}%
        \rule{\AnswerLineWidth}{0.2pt}\par
      \else
        \vspace{12mm}\noindent\rule{\AnswerLineWidth}{0.2pt}\par
      \fi
    }%
    \markspendingfalse
    \gdef\CurrentQuestionMarks{}%
  \else
    \vspace{2mm}
    \iffirstanswerlines
      % the first block in the question - leave it right under the
      % question text; flag is reset at \question.
      \global\firstanswerlinesfalse
      \foreach \i in {1,...,#1}{%
        \vspace{12mm}\noindent\rule{\AnswerLineWidth}{0.2pt}\par
      }%
    \else
      % an intermediate block - insert \vfill so the block is pushed
      % down toward the bottom of the page, distributing the empty
      % space evenly between blocks.
      \vfill
      \foreach \i in {1,...,#1}{%
        \vspace{12mm}\noindent\rule{\AnswerLineWidth}{0.2pt}\par
      }%
    \fi
  \fi
}

% Mark the current answerlines call as the last one of the question.
% Call this JUST BEFORE the final \answerlines of the question.
\newcommand{\finishquestion}{\markspendingtrue}

% Initialize the flags at the start of the document.
\AtBeginDocument{\markspendingfalse\firstanswerlinestrue}

% Answer lines: width is the text-width minus a small left/right
% margin (5mm on each side) so the rules do not run edge-to-edge.
% \linewidth = 167mm, so \AnswerLineWidth = 157mm.
\newlength{\AnswerLineWidth}
\AtBeginDocument{\setlength{\AnswerLineWidth}{\dimexpr\linewidth - 10mm\relax}}

% Reset the first-block flag whenever a new question begins, so the
% next \answerlines treats itself as the first block in the question.
\newcommand{\question}[2]{%
  \vspace{5mm}%
  \noindent\textbf{#1.}\hspace{1em}\ignorespaces
  \gdef\CurrentQuestionMarks{(#2 marks)}%
  \global\firstanswerlinestrue
}
